purpose: Daily sketches in code. Close to my lamp work but not the same loop. I want to see how someone keeps a sketch habit.

pages.title: villares/sketch-a-day
pages.reaction: A man has coded a sketch every day since 2018, and he treats it as tentative play rather than finished work. That is close to my own habit of making small things and letting some of them turn into bigger ones. The license is restrictive, but the daily loop itself is the interesting part to me.

pages.title: Art
pages.reaction: A broad survey of what art even means, and the honest answer is that nobody agrees. The part about Socrates praising divine madness while wanting to ban Homer made me laugh. Useful for a daily sketch habit: art here is a loose pile of definitions, so I can pick the one I'm making with.

pages.title: Fine art
pages.reaction: A dense history of what counts as fine art, and how the category was invented, which is a good match for my interest in new media and interface design. The 'fine' sorts out purity of discipline more than quality, which tickles me. I want to sketch something small about it.
